user.title: Authenticate with Aira Cloud
user.description:
Enter your **Aira account credentials** to list your available devices. This is required as your account holds an important key needed to access the device via Bluetooth.
_Your credentials are only used to fetch this key and are not stored_

select_device.title: Select Your Device
select_device.description:
Found **{device_count} device(s)** in your Aira account. Select the device you want to add.
If your device is not listed, ensure it is registered in your Aira account. (Heat pumps are the only supported device type for now)

configure.title: Configure Device Settings
configure.description:
Set how often data should be read from your device. The default is **{default_interval} seconds**. Lower values provide more frequent updates but may cause more errors.
Adjust the **number of zones** and **number of phases** if the detected one is incorrect.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device. Please check the MAC address and ensure the device is powered on and within range.
error.invalid_mac: Invalid MAC address format. Please use format XX:XX:XX:XX:XX:XX
error.invalid_auth: Invalid email or password. Please check your credentials.
error.no_devices_found: No devices found in your Aira account.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred, please try again or check the logs.
error.cloud_timeout: The cloud service did not respond in time. Please try again later.
error.cloud_unavailable: The cloud service is currently unavailable. Please try again later.
error.cloud_error: An error occurred while communicating with the cloud service. Please try again later.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup for this Aira device is already in progress. This may happen if Home Assistant already discovered it via Bluetooth — check your integrations page for a pending discovery.
abort.unsupported_device: The selected device is not supported. Only Aira Heat Pumps can be configured for now.
abort.already_configured: This device is already configured. Please select another device.
abort.no_devices_found: All devices available in your Aira account are already configured. No new devices to add.
abort.bluetooth_unavailable: Bluetooth is not available. Please ensure Bluetooth is enabled on your Home Assistant host.
abort.device_not_found: Invalid device. Selected device was not found in your Aira account. Make sure the device is registered in your account.
abort.ble_device_not_found: BLE device not found. Make sure your Aira device is powered on and within Bluetooth range (5-15m). If the device is too far try using a Bluetooth adapter or Bluetooth repeaters like esphome.
abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the selected device. Please ensure your Aira device is powered on and within range.
abort.not_aira_device: The discovered device is not an Aira device. Only Aira Heat Pumps can be configured for now.
abort.unknown: An unexpected error occurred during setup.

temperature_not_provided.message: Temperature not provided. Please specify a temperature in °С.

invalid_temperature.message: Temperature must be one of: {allowed_temperatures}°C. Received: {temperature}°C. Use + / - button if unsure.

scheduler_active.message: Cannot set temperature while scheduler is active. Please disable the scheduler first.

unsupported_set_temp.message: Can't set temperature for {hvac_mode} setpoint when the heat pump is in {pump_mode_state} mode.

temperature_out_of_range.message: Temperature {temperature}°C is out of range. Must be between {min_temp}°C and {max_temp}°C.

init.title: Configure Device
init.description:
Update the settings for your Aira Device.
Adjust the **update interval** to change how often data is read from your device. Lower values provide more frequent updates but may cause more errors.
Modify the **number of zones** and **number of phases** if the detected one is incorrect.

migration_required.title: Aira integration needs to be reconfigured
migration_required.description:
This Aira instance was set up with an older version and is no longer compatible. Please delete it and set it up again.
Sensors will be recreated with the same internal ID, so everything should stay intact.
